messages:
Niko: hey team! i'm Niko — joining as a backend infra engineer (formerly at Drift). pronouns he/him. just finished my first day, excited to be here :tada:
Mira: welcome Niko! where are you based?
Niko: Portland, OR. usually in the office tues/thurs. big fan of thermoses and rainy walks.
Sam: welcome!! if you're into taproom runs we usually do one friday a month. also there's a kombucha fridge :sparkles: 
Talia: omg kombucha fridge is sacred. also we have a 'plant water rota' board in the kitchen if you want to claim a plant :seedling: 
Niko: i'll take a plant! which one is the low-effort one? :sweat_smile: 
Chris: snake plant in the corner is basically indestructible. i'll add you to the rota.
Mira: also if you want climbing buddies, @niko — @mira and i go on wednesdays after work :climbing: 
Niko: yes please. i bring terrible climbing shoes and great snacks :bread: 
welcome-bot: :tada: Welcome @Niko to Redwood! You were added to #new-hires and given 400 welcome credits.
Sam: quick logistics q — badge access? ask @people-ops if it didn't show up yet.
Niko: badge activated in the app, thanks! can confirm coffee machine is fantastic. any recs on local lunch spots?
Talia: for sandwiches: 'Union Deli' two blocks down. for ramen: 'Koi Ramen' on 4th.
Niko: thanks! i'll bring pastries tomorrow morning as a proper hello (maple-y things).
Mira: :heart: see you all tomorrow!
Sam: :thumbsup: 
Chris: welcome aboard, Niko!
